description: Gaussian splat of a furnished apartment trained with Brush from Meta's Eyeful Tower dataset (VR-NeRF, SIGGRAPH Asia 2023; 22-camera rig, metric poses).

provenance.source: Eyeful Tower 'apartment' by Meta Platforms, Inc. (MIT licence): colmap/images_8, every 3rd rig position
notes: Camera poses and scale from the dataset's own COLMAP export (metric).
Reconstruction-to-world transform baked into the splat, so worldFromReconstruction is identity.
Raw Brush output (clean_splat.py is tuned for handheld video and removed real furniture here).
